text:
rahul: Quick RFC follow-up: propose `deferredRetry` for paginated iterators. Goal: avoid head-of-line blocking when the immediate next page fails transiently by scheduling bounded background retries.

cam: Interesting. Need clear surface and strict resource bounds.

rahul: Sketch: default off. When enabled: 1) return page N synchronously; 2) if fetch for N+1 fails transiently, schedule a retry worker with bounded queue/backoff; 3) expose `iterator.prefetch(depth)` and `iterator.deferredRetryPolicy(opts)` for advanced control. Example (TS):
```ts
const it = client.listItems({pageSize:100, deferredRetry:true});
for await (const page of it.pages()) { /* process page */ }
it.prefetch(2);
it.deferredRetryPolicy({maxAttempts:5, baseBackoffMs:200});
```

tina: Cancellation: caller stop should cancel background work and free buffers. Also surface telemetry keys: queuedRetries, activeRetries, lastRetryError.

eli: Language constraints: Python sync iterators -> single background thread (ThreadPoolExecutor limited to 1 per iterator); prefer async iterators for concurrency. Node -> internal async tasks. Go -> goroutine with token bucket/limit.

sasha: Idempotency: only safe when endpoint is read-only or server includes `retryHint.safeToRetry=true`. Otherwise default to disabled.

cam: Add `retryHint: { safeToRetry: bool, suggestedBackoffMs: number }` in responses; SDKs respect by default.

rahul: Resource bounds: prefetch queue size = depth * pageSize; cap total bytes and in-flight retries; default depth=1.

eli: Ordering: iterator must yield pages in sequence. Background retries only fill immediate gaps; do not race ahead.

rahul: Failure semantics: if retries exhaust, iterator surfaces terminal error on next access. Expose `onDeferredRetryExhausted` hook for fallbacks.

cam: Tests: unit tests for cancellation & cleanup, stress tests many iterators, e2e with flaky network.

tina: Telemetry & cost: track retry_rpc_count, extra_tokens, queued_retry_count. Add env flag `DEFERRED_RETRY_VERBOSE` for local debug traces.

eli: Python API: `client.list_items(..., deferred_retry=True)` returns iterator with `.pages()` and `.close()` to cancel background worker.

sasha: Go API sketch: `it := client.ListItems(ctx, opts.WithDeferredRetry(true)); defer it.Close(); for it.Next() { pg := it.Page() } if err := it.Err(); err != nil {}`

rahul: Security: avoid retrying with one-time ephemeral tokens; integrate with auth refresh.

cam: Backcompat: disabled mode identical. Enabled mode documented invariants: no duplicates, ordering preserved, best-effort completion.

sasha: Server contract: missing retryHint -> conservative (safeToRetry=false) unless user overrides.

eli: I'll own Python spike + tests; sasha server contract; tina telemetry/perf; rahul will draft appendix.

ci-bot: deploy-checklist: feature-flag, integration-tests, perf-suite.

cam: Nice. Please draft short RFC appendix with per-lang API sketches, bounded semantics, telemetry keys, and retryHint proto. We'll review and approve spike window. :thumbsup:
